name: @ai-ecoverse/apple-developer
description: The apple-developer CLI for jsh: Apple Developer portal Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles from a logged-in developer.apple.com tab (teams, certificates, App IDs and capabilities, provisioning profiles: list, download, create). `pnpm add` it in /opt/user on SLICC 7, or `npm install -g` this folder to put `apple-developer` on PATH.
